result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Decide whether to develop and launch a specialized handoff tracking tool for small software development teams operating in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Investigation of handoff workflows and update overhead among small software engineering teams in Latvia.
- Evaluation of integration requirements with common developer tooling and documentation systems.
- Exclusion of payroll management, time-tracking for billing, and financial advisory functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Oversees team delivery cadence, sprint handoffs, and process efficiency.

- How many hours per week does your engineering team spend preparing, copying, and aligning handoff documentation? (question-56e10d5a99cb99d6fdc08caa)
- What limitations in your current project tracking stack prevent effective asynchronous handoffs? (question-b9c66ed8ce31019b713ce4ab)

## Software Developer

Executes feature development and writes daily status and handover notes.

- What specific manual data-entry steps are required when summarizing your work for team handoffs? (question-0d570d321538c3d5ed652f0b)
- Which version control or issue management tools would a handoff tracker need to read from to reduce manual reporting? (question-81f7a3f35611177d28851c4c)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software engineering teams in Latvia experience recurring weekly synchronization rituals that involve manual copying of status updates.
- The synthetic interview fixture is representative of friction experienced by target development teams.

## Evidence gaps

- No verified empirical market research on software team practices or budget allocation in Latvia.
- Uncertain whether teams would pay for a dedicated tracking tool rather than adapting existing documentation tools.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
